openStudio.stepBuy: Buy the package with your Wallet
openStudio.stepBuyDesc: Pay once from your Wallet balance. If you are short, top up exactly the missing amount via VietQR.
openStudio.stepCreateDesc: Name your Studio. You become its Producer and manage every Series in it.
openStudio.stepInviteDesc: Invite Writers, Artists, Letterers and Editors by email. They accept from their Notifications.
openStudio.stepPublish: Produce and hand off for release
openStudio.stepPublishDesc: Assign work chapter by chapter, the Editor approves, then hand off to the Publisher for release to readers.
openStudio.teamSubtitle: Each member has a clear role in the chapter production flow.
openStudio.faqRefundA: No. The package is charged once from your Wallet and stays active on your account permanently.
openStudio.faqRolesQ: Do the members I invite need to buy the package?
openStudio.faqRolesA: No. Only the Studio creator needs it. Invited members only need a PanelForge account and to accept the invitation.
openStudio.faqPublishQ: How are the Studio's series released?
openStudio.faqPublishA: After the Editor approves a chapter, the Studio hands it off to the Publisher, who sets it as free or paid and releases it to readers.
openStudio.faqReaderA: Yes. You keep reading, along with your Wallet, Library and unlocked chapters.
openStudio.guarantee: The package price is set by PanelForge. If it changes while you pay, checkout stops so you can review the new price before you are charged.

producer.summary: Plans the series, assigns work per chapter and tracks progress until hand-off for release.
producer.duty1: Create series and chapters, and invite members to the Studio.
producer.duty2: Assign work per stage and track deadlines.
producer.duty3: Hand off approved chapters to the Publisher.
producer.firstStep2: Invite a Writer, Artist, Letterer and Editor.
producer.firstStep3: Set up chapter 1 and assign work to each member.

writer.summary: Writes the script by scene and dialogue, linking characters to the Series Bible to stay consistent.
writer.duty1: Write the script by scene, panel and dialogue.
writer.duty2: Link characters and places to the Series Bible.
writer.duty3: Send the script for Editor review, then lock it.
writer.firstStep1: Open My work to see your assigned chapters.
writer.firstStep2: Read the Series Bible to learn the cast and world.
writer.firstStep3: Write the first scene and send it for review.

artist.summary: Lays out pages and draws pencils, inks and colors for each panel from the locked script.
artist.duty2: Upload pencils, inks and colors panel by panel.
artist.duty3: Revise from the Editor's region-marked change requests.
artist.firstStep1: Open My work to see your assigned pages.
artist.firstStep2: Check the locked script and character references.
artist.firstStep3: Lay out the first page and submit pencils.

letterer.summary: Places balloons, sound effects and captions on pages following the script and reading order.
letterer.duty1: Place balloons and captions from the script.
letterer.duty2: Add sound effects (SFX) and adjust lettering style.
letterer.duty3: Check the reading order before sending for review.
letterer.firstStep1: Open My work to see pages waiting for lettering.
letterer.firstStep2: Compare dialogue against the locked script.
letterer.firstStep3: Letter the first page and send it for review.

editor.summary: Reviews each chapter's script, art and lettering, and sends region-marked change requests when needed.
editor.duty1: Review scripts, artwork and lettered pages.
editor.duty2: Send change requests that mark the exact region to fix.
editor.duty3: Approve finished chapters so the Studio can hand them off for release.
editor.firstStep2: Read the Series Bible to learn the character standards.
editor.firstStep3: Review the first item or send a change request.

automationTab.title: Assignment Automation
automationTab.subtitle: Configure automatic stage handoff, reviewer routing, and deadline reminders for this Studio
automationTab.readOnlyHint: Only the Studio Owner or Producer can edit and save Automation settings.
automationTab.conflictMessage: Automation settings were just modified by someone else. Please reload to get the latest version.
automationTab.autoNextStageDesc: When a cell in the previous stage is approved, automatically assign eligible cells in the next stage.
automationTab.autoNextStageExample: Example: Page 3 finishes Pencil review → Ink for Page 3 is assigned automatically.
automationTab.assignModeInactiveHint: Turn on auto-assign above to apply this mode
automationTab.modeKeepPageOwnerDesc: Whoever worked on the page in the previous stage continues on it (falls back to load balancing).
automationTab.modeBalanceOnlyDesc: Assign the active member with the matching role who currently has the least open work.
automationTab.autoRouteReviewDesc: When work is submitted at an approval gate, suggest the Editor with the fewest pending reviews (soft assignment).
automationTab.autoRouteReviewExample: Example: Artist submits a page → pre-fills the least busy Editor as suggested reviewer (other Editors can still review).
automationTab.leadHoursHint: Between 1 and 168 hours before due time (default 24 hours).
automationTab.escalationToggleDesc: Automatically notify Producers when a lot stays overdue or an assigned cell sits unstarted too long.
automationTab.escalationHoursPlaceholder: Currently off (toggle on or enter hours)
automationTab.escalationHoursHint: Between 1 and 168 hours after due time or becoming startable.
automationTab.validationLeadHours: Remind before due must be between 1 and 168 hours.
automationTab.validationEscalationHours: Overdue alert hours must be blank or between 1 and 168 hours.
automationTab.recommendedPresetDesc: Quick setup for Studios: keep page owner, suggest Editor, and alert after 24h overdue.
automationTab.saveSuccessDesc: Studio Assign Automation settings have been updated.
automationTab.howItWorksFlow: Approve cell → system auto-assigns next stage (keep page owner or load balance) → assignee is notified → submit cell for review → suggests 1 Editor → overdue notifies Producer.
automationTab.activityLoadErrorFallback: Failed to load recent automation activity.
automationTab.activityEmptyHint: Once rules are enabled and cells move through stages, automated handoffs and alerts will appear here.
